title: Constant model family for localized fixed realization
statement: For schemes X,Z,T,S, maps g:Z→X, a:T→S and b:Z→T, and an adic coefficient datum d, let L_n be fixed realization after pro-etale inverse image along b. There is a family model_n(E) identifying L_n applied to the normalized constant comparison of every algebraic B_n-complex E with constantAdicQuotientRealization(g,d,n)(E).

theorem lisseTower_localized_constants_model
    {X Z T S : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ X) (a : T ⟶ S) (b : Z ⟶ T)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) :
    let L (j : ℕ) := (ProEtale.upperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d j)) b).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        lisseTowerFixedRealization g d j
    Nonempty (∀ (n : ℕ)
    (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n))),
    (L n).obj ((localProEtaleComparison a
      (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)).obj
        ((normalizationConstant S.smallEtaleTopology).obj E)) ≅
      (constantAdicQuotientRealization g d n).obj E)
